About this item

  • Application: Fit for 2009-2017 Toyota Corolla 1.8L L4 / 2017 Toyota Corolla IM 1.8L L4 / 2009-2014 Toyota Matrix 1.8L L4 / 2010-2015 Toyota Prius 1.8L L4 / 2012-2017 Toyota Prius V 1.8L L4 / 2011-2016 Lexus CT200h 1.8L L4 / 2016 Scion IM 1.8L L4 / 2008 -2014 Scion XD 1.8L L4 / 2009-2010 Pontiac Vibe 1.8L L4
  • Replaces Part Numbers: Ignition coils part numbers: UF596, UF-596, UF619, 90919-02258, 90919-02252, 90919C2005, 52-2126, IC686, C1714, E1096, GN10341, C1714-4, E1119. Please check whether your car model fits for our products in the "amazonconfirmfit" at the top left corner before ordering
  • High-quality Ignition Coils: The exterior of our ignition coils are made of epoxy resin and high-strength engineering plastic to prevent the ignition coils from being melted due to overheating of the engine; and the interior of coils are made of high-conductivity copper coil to increase the ignition speed
  • Excellent Spark Plugs: Our spark plugs are made of double iridium electrode and an advanced center to produce complete and efficient combustion and provide an excellent spark for faster, stronger and more powerful combustion over the life of the plug. The corrosion-resistant center and ground electrodes minimize spark gap growth, providing greater combustibility and spark efficiency, it improves engine performance as powerful as a new car and start quickly and speed up in a short time
  • Easy Installation: All coils and and spark plugs meet or exceed OE design and performance. Strict testing procedure and superior materials, which provide maximum strength and durability. The quality, durability, and reliability of all products are backed by over 50 years of excellence in experience and know how. It is sure to easy installation and safe operation
  • Worryfree Aftermarket 1-Year-Warranty. Package includes 4 ignition coils and 4 spark plugs. If you get any problems with our products, please contact us in the first time, we will response it as soon as possible. Your satisfaction is the goal of our service

    • The Rusty Hatchet Farms
      5 out of 5 stars
      Solved my misfire and was quick to install
      Reviewed in the United States on March 14, 2026
      Set name: UF575
      Verified Purchase
      Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
      Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

      These ignition coils arrived on time, I installed them in my VW, and they did exactly what I needed them to do. The misfiring stopped, the car started running better, and the installation did not take long at all. That is really the main thing you want from a part like this: put it in, fix the problem, and get back on the road.

      What I liked most is that this set gives you all 5 coils, so it feels like a practical package if you want to replace everything at once instead of chasing one bad coil at a time. The listing also markets this as a 5-piece UF575 coil pack set for a wide range of VW and Audi applications, including several 2.5L Volkswagen models and multiple Audi fitments, so it is clearly aimed at people doing a full replacement job.

      Installation was straightforward for me, and once they were in, the difference was noticeable. The product listing describes them as a direct OEM-style replacement for part numbers including 07K905715A and related variants, which matches the kind of simple swap experience I had.

      So far, I can say they work and do the job. If you are dealing with a misfire and need a replacement coil pack set for one of the compatible vehicles, this was a good buy in my experience.
